$comment: Hand-maintained known-discrepancy overlay for `pnpm drift` (packages/drift/README.md#known-discrepancy-overlay). Each entry accepts one finding `kind` at one `path` of one `operation` (both exactly as printed in drift-output/report.md; path "*" = any path in the operation) for a `marketplace`; matching findings are reported as `accepted` (info) with the `reason`. Entries that match nothing are listed as stale — remove them. It lives here, not in specs/, because the Hepsiburada specs are redistributed unchanged and specs/trendyol is generated. Keep entries sorted by marketplace, operation, path.
